title: `gennady sync` overwrites locally modified directives, including the project-owned knowledge.xml registry
Execution Log has no token for correcting an earlier line; an invented `correction` is rejected as unknown-token
Handoff and Inputs carry no provenance: an orchestrator's guess reaches the next agent as a measured fact
Isolated critic cannot see the scope's conventions (tasks/README.md), so it re-raises settled taxonomy as findings
`sdd verify --wip <target-files>` does not narrow gates: a one-file phase runs every extraGate, and `--only` cannot name a new gate
phase-execution-protocol forbids every git command, but gate/script phases need throwaway git fixtures to prove anything
A passing gate's output is discarded, so a gate that narrows its scope cannot report what it actually ran
Nine SDD skills instruct the agent to announce 'DIRECTIVE ACTIVATED', which the directive they load forbids by name
critic.directive.xml writes '### Round N' into the ticket file, colliding with the Execution Log heading owned by scaffold/fix
Reopens is defined two ways: audit enforces `Round headers − 1` while rounds are opened for reasons that are not reopens
SDD directives invoke the sdd tooling via ~/.claude/skills/, but sync-skills installs it into <cwd>/.claude/skills/
SDD tooling: 5 issues from running the full loop on a Swift project (path-based Task-IDs invisible, sync deletes local skills)
